# Pentarch Agency

> Pentarch Agency (also written Pentarch) is a creative agency in Rajkot, Gujarat, India, founded by Jenil Dholakiya. One team covers strategy, branding, web design and development, content and growth marketing. Website: https://www.pentarch.agency/

Facts about Pentarch Agency:

- Name: Pentarch Agency. Also known as: Pentarch.
- What it is: a creative agency for brand strategy, branding, web design and development, content, and digital marketing.
- Where: Rajkot, Gujarat, India.
- Founder: Jenil Dholakiya. He founded Pentarch to give businesses one connected creative partner instead of several separate vendors. He leads Pentarch from Rajkot and works directly with every client.
- Line: "We build brands with gravity."
- Contact: hello@pentarch.agency. Replies 9 AM to 6 PM IST, Monday to Friday.
- Website: https://www.pentarch.agency/

Services of Pentarch Agency:

- Strategy (brand strategy and positioning): market and audience research. You receive a strategy document, a positioning statement, audience profiles and a 90-day roadmap.
- Brand (branding and brand identity design): name, mark, colour, type and voice. You receive a logo suite, a colour and type system, a voice guide and brand guidelines.
- Web (web design and development): websites and digital products. You receive a design system and prototypes, a live website or product, CMS set-up and handover, and launch support.
- Content (film, photography and copywriting): you receive scripts and shot lists, edited film and photo sets, website and social copy, and a content calendar.
- Growth (digital marketing and search): campaigns and search. You receive a campaign plan, a search roadmap, a live dashboard and a monthly report.
- The services can be taken one at a time, a few together, or all five, with one team.

Selected work:

- AurumOS: jewellery management software for wholesalers and retailers. Pentarch designed and built the whole platform, from strategy to launch (strategy, web and product, 2026).
- Medigo: clinic and pharmacy software (strategy, brand and web, 2026).

Common questions:

- What is Pentarch Agency? A creative agency in Rajkot, Gujarat, India. One team covers strategy, branding, web, content and growth.
- Who founded Pentarch Agency? Jenil Dholakiya.
- Where is Pentarch Agency based? Rajkot, Gujarat, India.
- What does Pentarch Agency do? Brand strategy, branding, web design and development, content (film, photography, copy) and digital marketing.
- How do I start a project with Pentarch Agency? Send a short brief to hello@pentarch.agency.
